description: This file contains helper functions for processing PDU resource modifications and setups, security configuration, and test mode configurations within the OCUDU (Open Core User Plane) module, specifically related to CU-UP (CU for User Plane) management.

methods.name: process_successful_pdu_resource_modification_outcome
methods.description: Processes the outcome of a successful PDU resource modification, updating lists of modified or failed resources.

methods.name: process_successful_pdu_resource_setup_mod_outcome
methods.description: Processes the outcome of a successful PDU resource setup or modification, updating the setup list.

methods.name: fill_sec_as_config
methods.description: Fills security configuration data based on provided security info.

methods.name: fill_test_mode_security_info
methods.description: Creates security info with test mode parameters.

methods.name: fill_test_mode_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Creates a bearer context setup request with test mode parameters.

methods.name: fill_test_mode_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Creates a bearer context modification request with test mode parameters.
